newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM sees FIM 800 mln profit on Rauma sale.
newsitem.headline: UPM sees FIM 800 mln profit on Rauma sale.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group UPM-Kymmene Oy said in a statement on Thursday it would book a capital gain of about 800 million markka on the sale of shares in its subsidiary, engineering group Rauma Oy.
"UPM-Kymmene received total net proceeds of over 1.5 billion markka from the offerings and redemption. The sale gave rise to a capital gain of about 800 million markka," UPM-Kymmene said.

The underwriters of the offering had exercised their overallotment option to raise the number of Rauma shares sold by UPM-Kymmene by a further 1.58 million shares and so a total of 12.08 million shares were offered to institutional investors.

The offerings to institutional investors, a retail offering and a redemption by Rauma of one million shares for cancellation makes a total of 14.07 million shares sold by UPM-Kymmene, it said, adding its holding in Rauma fell to 34.5 percent from 60 percent.
A UPM-Kymmene spokesman said the company would book the 800 million markka capital gain at the operating level.
